title: Members of various Lingayat organisations take out protests against author Ravi Hanjagimath

ai.summary: Lingayat organisations protested against author Ravi Hanjagimath for allegedly insulting Basavanna and other Sharanas, demanding legal action and a ban on the book Basava Mantapa.

facts.claim: Lingayat organisations took out protests against author Ravi Hanjagimath
facts.quote: Members of various Lingayat organisations took out protests against author Ravi Hanjagimath, for allegedly insulting Basavanna and other Sharanas, in Belagavi and Vijayapura on Friday.

facts.claim: Protesters demanded action against the author and Vishwavani TV channel
facts.quote: Protesters demanded action against the author and the Vishwavani TV channel for broadcasting the controversial interview.

facts.claim: Protesters staged a dharna at Deputy Commissioner's office in Belagavi
facts.quote: Protesters gathered at the office of the Deputy Commissioner in Belagavi and staged a dharna.

facts.claim: Protesters sought legal action and a permanent ban on the book Basava Mantapa
facts.quote: They sought legal action against them. They sought a permanent ban on the sale of the book Basava Mantapa, written by Mr. Hanjagimath and published by Mr. Bhat.

facts.claim: Allamaprabhu Swami stated that undermining Basavanna's character was unacceptable
facts.quote: Allamaprabhu Swami stated that any attempt to undermine the character and ideals of Basavanna was not acceptable.

facts.claim: Allamaprabhu Swami warned of intensified agitations if accused were not punished
facts.quote: He warned of intensified agitations if the accused were not punished immediately.

facts.claim: Sri Channabasava Swami demanded the author be arrested even if abroad
facts.quote: The author must be arrested even if he is settled abroad,

ai.background_note: Lingayat organisations, a major religious group in Karnataka, protested against author Ravi Hanjagimath for allegedly insulting Basavanna, a 12th-century religious reformer, and other Sharanas (followers of Lingayatism).
